description: HardeningModule startup-hardening expansion: 1A add an audit-first ASR tier (new AsrRulesAudit array written as '2', verified/re-armed/deleted alongside the existing Block tier) and 1B apply self-only process mitigations via SetProcessMitigationPolicy in the ApplyOrFail self-protect block, with BlockNonMicrosoftBinaries gated behind an Authenticode-signed-build check. All in src/Sentinel.Core/HardeningModule.cs; independent of FEAT-002.
steps: 1A arrays: In e:\Gorstak\Sentinel\.worktrees\hips-phase1\src\Sentinel.Core\HardeningModule.cs add 'internal static readonly (string Guid, string Name)[] AsrRulesAudit' next to the existing AsrRules array, containing ONLY these GUID-confirmed, lockout-capable rules: 7674ba52-37eb-4a4f-a9a1-f0f9a1619a2c (Block Adobe Reader from creating child processes), c0033c00-d16d-4114-a5a0-dc9b3a7d2ceb (Block use of copied or impersonated system tools), 01443614-cd74-433a-b99e-2ecdc07bfc25 (Block executable files from running unless they meet a prevalence/age/trusted-list criterion). Add XML doc comments explaining the audit-first ('2') rationale: these can break legitimate software, so they are observed in Audit and only promoted to Block after a clean field window. Do NOT add the Safe-Mode-reboot GUID. Do NOT add c1db55ab anywhere (it stays in AsrRulesNeverBlock).

1A ApplyAsrRules(): after the existing 'foreach (var (guid, _) in AsrRules) key.SetValue(guid, "1", ...)' loop and before the AsrRulesNeverBlock delete loop, add 'foreach (var (guid, _) in AsrRulesAudit) key.SetValue(guid, "2", ...)'. Keep ApplyAsrOnlyExclusions() calls and all existing logic unchanged.

1A IsAsrPolicyIntact(): after the existing AsrRules Block check, add a loop asserting every AsrRulesAudit GUID is present and equals "2" (return false otherwise). Keep the AsrRulesNeverBlock absence check unchanged.

1A ReleaseAsrBlockPolicy(): add a loop deleting every AsrRulesAudit GUID (key.DeleteValue(guid, throwOnMissingValue: false)) alongside the existing AsrRules and AsrRulesNeverBlock delete loops, so teardown is symmetric.

1B P/Invoke + types: add '[DllImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError = true)] private static extern bool SetProcessMitigationPolicy(int policy, ref <struct> lpBuffer, UIntPtr dwLength)' (one overload per policy struct, or a generic marshalled approach) using the stable PROCESS_MITIGATION_POLICY ordinals: DEP=1, ControlFlowGuard=7, Signature=8, ExtensionPointDisable=9, ImageLoad=10, StrictHandleCheck=11. Add [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)] policy structs with the correct bitfield DWORD flags (DEP permanent; CFG EnableControlFlowGuard; StrictHandleCheck RaiseExceptionOnInvalidHandleReference+HandleExceptionsPermanentlyEnabled; ExtensionPointDisable DisableExtensionPoints; ImageLoad NoRemoteImages+NoLowMandatoryLabelImages+PreferSystem32Images; Signature MicrosoftSignedOnly for BlockNonMicrosoftBinaries). Follow the P/Invoke+struct style in NativeProcessMemory.cs.

1B pure helper: add 'internal static <PlanType> GetSelfMitigationPlan(bool processImageIsAuthenticodeSigned)' returning the set of mitigations to apply. Always include DEP-permanent, StrictHandleCheck, ExtensionPointDisable, CFG, and the three image-load flags. Include BlockNonMicrosoftBinaries ONLY when processImageIsAuthenticodeSigned is true. The helper must be pure (no P/Invoke, no I/O) so it is unit-testable. If BlockNonMicrosoftBinaries is instead omitted entirely for Phase 1, still expose the signed-vs-unsigned decision via this helper and add a code comment that broad signature enforcement is Phase 3 opt-in.

1B application: in ApplyOrFail(), in the self-protect block immediately after 'SetDefaultDllDirectories(LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_SYSTEM32)', resolve the current process image path (SecurityValidation.GetProcessImagePath(System.Net48Environment.ProcessId) or Process.GetCurrentProcess().MainModule?.FileName), compute signed = that path is non-empty && SecurityValidation.VerifyAuthenticodeSignature(path), build the plan via GetSelfMitigationPlan(signed), then apply each mitigation via SetProcessMitigationPolicy inside its OWN try/catch that logs at Debug on failure (Debug.WriteLine). The method must still return its existing bool and never throw; the service must start as a standard user. Log each applied mitigation at Debug.
